case.summary: Customer C08106 initially disputed a $128.33 online transaction (ID 3583227) on card C08106-K1, claiming it was unauthorized. The transaction originated from a new device profile that is linked via community detection to a high-risk cluster with a fraud rate 9.2 times the bank average. Despite the suspicious device profile and the card's history of prior fraud (CC-3778), the customer was contacted for verification. Upon review, the customer identified the transaction as a household purchase and withdrew the dispute.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: On review of the merchant and date, the customer recognises the purchase (a household/own purchase) and withdraws the dispute
